layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Spinosaurid piscivore snout morphology
features: A long, slender clay snout resembling a gharial, designed for catching fish
The snout features numerous thin, interlocking white clay teeth that protrude slightly from the jaw
The end of the snout has a small bulbous 'boss' with visible nostrils
Textured olive-green clay skin with heavy scale patterns and a pale underbelly
A slight, confident curve to the mouth line and a focused, reptilian clay eye
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic profile shot of the long, narrow snout. The lighting is crisp, highlighting the wet-look clay texture and the fine detail of the needle-like teeth. This serves as a 'Gharial Snout' morphology icon. No text.
